Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
sid...@umdsun2.umd.umich.edu (mike bist) writes:

>Can a Rotschreck be played on a vamp in a dawn operation?

if that vampire attempts a strike which would deal damage
(a hand strike, any weapon strike except Rowan Ring, etc.)
then yes.
If the vampire merely dodges or ends combat, then no.
(or if the vamp has zero hand damage for whatever reason).
